review:
A royal candy land on a 7x7 cluster grid – cakes, doughnuts and chocolates pay in clusters of five or more and tumble.

Treasure chest cash symbols stick through tumbles, but only pay when a key-shaped Collector lands at the same time. Three scatters give 10 free spins where cash symbols get a lifespan of one to five spins, giving them more chances to be collected. Up to 10,000x, 96.53% RTP.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
